# YAML の見本
%YAML 1.2
---
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, "release/**"]
  pull_request: {}
env: &defaults
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
  LANG: "ja_JP.UTF-8"
jobs:
  build:
    <<: *defaults
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: 実行
        run: |
          cargo build --release
          echo "done: $GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: folded
        run: >-
          echo one
          echo two
      - if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'push' }}
        run: echo 'single ''quoted'''
numbers: [0x1F, 0o17, 1.5e-3, .inf, -.Inf, .NaN, ~, null, true, no]
date: 2026-10-31T02:20:00+09:00
? complex key
: complex value
tagged: !!str 123
binary: !!binary R0lGODlhDAAMAIQAAP
...
